title: Wire MuerteSubita + ModoPinata evento behavioral effects once a lives/damage-capable mechanic exists
description: Filed from the TASK-042 review (rev-t042 LOW-5). TASK-042 wired the 5 §5.5 eventos as RoundModifiers reaching the session state channel (LastRoundModifier), with concrete behavioral effects for DobleVelocidad (next-microgame difficultyMult x1.5) and Apagon (score HUD hidden until GameOver) — the two AC3 names explicitly. MuerteSubita ('en el siguiente microjuego de supervivencia, un golpe elimina') and ModoPinata ('todo daño derrama monedas al suelo') reach LastRoundModifier but have NO behavioral effect today because no shipped mechanic has a 'lives'/'multi-hit-survival' or a 'damage'/'hit' concept to hook onto (MECH_02 Esquiva is already unconditionally one-hit-eliminate by its own core rule, so MuerteSubita would be a no-op even if wired). This is an honest, flagged gap (AC3's literal text is satisfied — the modifiers reach the channel). WORK (deferred, blocked on future mechanics): when a survival mechanic with a lives/multi-hit concept and/or a mechanic with a 'damage' event exists (candidates: MECH_06/07 asymmetric T-111 / TASK-040, MECH_08/09 coop T-112 / TASK-041), wire MuerteSubita to force one-hit elimination in that mechanic and ModoPinata to spill coins to the board floor on each damage/hit event (as visible CoinDeltas). Until then this is not actionable. Read GDD §5.5 + the TASK-042 evento-application code (SessionStateMachine.FinishBoardResolve).
acceptance_criteria: When a lives/multi-hit survival mechanic exists, MuerteSubita forces one-hit elimination in the next survival microgame (behavioral effect, tested)
When a mechanic with a damage/hit event exists, ModoPinata spills coins to the board floor per hit as visible origin->destination CoinDeltas (conservation preserved)
Until such mechanics exist this ticket stays blocked; the modifiers continuing to reach LastRoundModifier is verified (no regression of the TASK-042 reachability)
